summary: First-iteration full-stack testing for RajivFreelancer.com. Backend (9/9 pytest tests pass) and frontend (all critical flows working) verified. Contact form end-to-end flow persists to Mongo `leads` collection and shows success UI + toast.

issues: Portrait uses a random Unsplash photo (man in white coat with stethoscope) — not the actual Rajiv. Non-blocking placeholder but should be replaced with a real portrait before production.

action_items: Consider replacing hero portrait Unsplash image with a real photo of Rajiv (currently shows an unrelated stock person).
WhatsApp number (+91 9999999999) and Calendly URL are documented placeholders — remember to swap before launch.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `create_lead` inserts `lead.model_dump()` which includes `EmailStr` (fine, coerced to str). Response uses response_model=Lead so Mongo _id is never leaked — good.
GET /api/leads is currently unauthenticated and exposes all lead PII. Recommend adding auth/admin protection before production.
Email notify path is fire-and-forget with try/except and best-effort logging — good; no failure propagated to client (per requirement).
Frontend Contact.jsx uses `${process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/api` correctly. Toast + success state both wired.
Client-side validation only checks name/email/message (not project_type/budget). Since selects default to a value, that is acceptable but consider validating empty state for consistency.

Consider adding email format validation client-side before POST (currently server returns 422 which Contact.jsx swallows into a generic 'Could not send' toast — user won't know it was an invalid email).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed leads during testing (1 via API, 1 via UI). Both cleaned up post-test; leads collection is now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Test-created leads are prefixed with TEST_ and email starts with test_ or testui_ — safe to clean via db.leads.delete_many. Frontend uses Lenis smooth scroll; add ~2s wait after nav clicks before asserting section visibility. Contact form success state selector: [data-testid='contact-success']. Sonner toasts appear in body with class contains 'toast'. Hero portrait is a placeholder Unsplash image.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. All 13 requested features (5 backend + 8 frontend flows) verified working. Contact form POST -> Mongo persistence confirmed via direct db count check (2 documents inserted during test, cleaned up after).
